notes.title: New update: drastic changes to form management!
notes.content: From now on, a manager will have less difficulty getting a player back into a great form. In particular, peak form training program will be much more effective. Match results are still the best opportunity to improve your player's form, but beware: a big, unexpected defeat could cause it to drop drastically!

notes.title: Tennis Manager 2024 Fantasy Court’s London Championship
notes.content:
This summer, during grass season, dive into the action with our Fantasy Court’s London Championship, where you'll have the unique opportunity to manage and play as one of the serve & volley legends against the current stars of the game.

Experience the thrill of managing the reincarnation of a grass-court legend, put your skills to the test as you face off against today's top players and aim for the top of our multiplayer ranking leaderboard by achieving the highest scores to win one of our exclusive gifts.

Ensure your Tennis Manager 2024 is updated to the latest version, and you’ll be able to see the new mod in Fantasy Court’s menu. Play your matches and accumulate points to climb the multiplayer rankings and don’t forget to keep an eye on the leaderboard to see where you stand.

Best of luck managers and reconquer the courts.

notes.title: Update 4.4
notes.content:
This update contains numerous adjustments to the match simulation and new features in Fantasy Court mode, including a competition based around the Grand Slam tournament on grass!

New:
[list]
[*] Fantasy Court : You can now publish on the steam Workshop your mods for Fantasy Court. An online leaderboard lets players compare themselves!
[*] Fantasy Court : "London Championships - Official Tournament". Who will be the best on grass?
[/list]
Match Simulation Balancing:
[list]
[*] Improvements on Serve, return and Key points intensities: impacts on player's attributes and behaviours
[*] Retakes on volleys: the player plays more different types of volleys
[*] Minor fixes on player's speed, lob depth and accuracy for topspin groundstrokes
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] World Cup: if you were the captain of specific countries, the e-mail asking you to choose the city for the next phase might not offer a choice, causing a block
[*] Have an error and restart a save game or start a new game without closing the game could cause in some cases new errors
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 4.3.1254
notes.content:
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Sometimes a voyage was not deleted from the calendar, even if it was no longer needed.
[*] Round-robin tournaments can now start with up to two byes.
[*] Setting a custom program as a favorite no more disble travels.
[*] When managing custom academies, retirement notifications were not sent.
[*] Four staff members did not have a photo associated with their profile.
[*] Some records have been corrected for top players (only for new careers).
[*] The best career rank displayed on the player profile screen was incorrect in some cases.
[*] Minor updates have been made to the user interface and localization.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v4.2.1226
notes.content:
Fixes:
[list]
[*] The "objective not completed" emails are no longer sent for players who have recently signed a contract.
[*] The rounds reached displayed in the Players' records screen are now correctly colorized.
[*] The game is no longer prone to crashing when clicking too quickly when a new career is created.
[*] When creating an academy, recruited players were not registered correctly.
[*] Training: program doesn't update for 2nd week of tournament
[*] Clicking on a World Cup tournament from the Team Supervision screen did not lead to the expected screen, causing a navigation issue
[*] Minor UI and localization fixes
[/list]
Adds:
[list]
[*] Sport Center infrastructures now have two new bonuses: Shape Bonus and Game Plan Mastery Bonus.
[*] The level of each infrastructure is now displayed.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v4.1.1202
notes.content:
Balancing:
[list]
[list]
[*] Form Balancing in Non-Simulated Matches: Adjustments made to reduce the impact of form on match results.
[/list]
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Training Program Deletion Bug: Fixed an issue where training program settings were not removed when deleting a custom program, which caused crashes at the start of a new season.
[*] Post-Tournament Training Program Customization: Customization of post-tournament training programs is no longer allowed to prevent crashes.
[*] Tournament Registration Issue: Resolved an issue where players could not register for a tournament despite meeting the conditions, primarily occurring at the start of a season.
[*] World Cup Player Selection Bug: Addressed an issue preventing player selection for World Cup phases, which could cause the game to crash. The game no longer crashes, but further investigation into the root cause is ongoing.
[*] Training Session Scheduling: Corrected instances where training sessions were scheduled between two matches, which should not occur.
[*] Minor Text Fixes: Improved English text and press conference consistency (special thanks to Urcaguary).
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 4.0.1184
notes.content:
Before the weekend, we're updating the game with a form rebalancing and some more minor fixes

Balancing:
[list]
[*] New Form balancing to reduce the impact of the form on the results
[*] Minor fixes on size and records of tennis women (only for new carreers)
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Calendar could display the wrong week n°1 depending on the year
[*] It was sometimes not possible to access the player screen when scouting has been started
[/list]
Localisation fixes:
[list]
[*] Tournement category JTL Girls 100 was named JTL Girls 200 in French
[*] The displayed initial contract duration for a created player was wrong (5 instead of 3)
[/list]

Don't forget to reload Steam of you don't see the update.

The Rebound team.

notes.title: Hotfix 4.0.1173
notes.content:
This is a minor update for Tennis Manager 2024.
We've focused on the balancing and the issues on the mac version; thanks again to our community!

Fixes & Balancing:
[list]
[*] Players in the academy now progress at a more consistent rate.
[*] Difficulty level now affects player progression as intended.
[*] Match results are now more realistic and less random.
[*] Players were losing too much morale and form; this has been corrected.
[*] Players gain more XP points according to their results
[*] Balancing modifications on some players' attributes (only when starting a new career)
[*] Gameplan and Surface training sessions now display the correct Gameplan indicator.
[*] Training screens no longer crash when a custom program is deleted.
[*] Mac-specific issues:
[list]
[*] The game no longer crashes randomly.
[*] Texts are now displayed correctly at the correct resolution.
[/list]
[/list]
Improvements:
[list]
[*] Optimized the Calendar feature for improved performance.
[/list]

Remember to restart Steam if you haven't received the update.

The Rebound team.

notes.title: Hotfix 4.0.1150
notes.content:
This is a minor update for Tennis Manager 2024.
We've focused on a few technical bug fixes found by the community; thanks again!

Fixes :
[list]
[*] The calendar becomes slower and slower as the game session went on.
[*] The calendar sometimes crashes on auto save.
[*] The game crashes when accepting wild cards when already registered to a tournament.
[*] Trainings session should not be set before a match.
[*] 2 staff's attributes were not correctly named
[*] Little UI & text fixes.
[/list]

Remember to restart Steam if you haven't received the update.

The Rebound team
